title: The Truth Bell Mystery
moral: Truth and clever thinking are stronger than lies and deception.

story: Sir Elowen investigates when the Truth Bell rings, signaling deception. A messenger claims a village has betrayed the kingdom, but Elowen suspects lies. Traveling with Pip, she faces danger and uncovers a plot where enemies spread false information to create conflict. By revealing the truth, she restores trust and prevents chaos, proving that intelligence and honesty are powerful.
